named_family: Calibration-Routed Set Temporal Transformer with an explicitly declared finite temporal-backbone set
interpretation: Shared architecture family, not identical networks or cross-dataset shared trained weights.
engineering_default_for_new_backbones: m2_like, not a globally selected scientific winner
routing_difference: Only calibration-conditioned additive slot-to-unit attention logit bias; never temporal kernel selection.
shared_must: Concat local16/E0/T4 Linear256-GELU-Linear256-LayerNorm; proven exact factorization allowed
8-slot 8-head width256 set attention with identical unit-mask semantics
Slot residual FFN256-1024-256 and flatten2048-to256 projection
Width256 heads8 depth4 FFN512; each named temporal member has identical semantics across datasets and within a FLAT/ROUTE pair
FW-CausalPE4 uses window-relative sinusoidal PE; FW-QueryAge16 uses original-memory four-query updates and linear age16; no hidden log-age/recency change
Final LayerNorm and last-position Linear256-128-GELU-to-task-output readout
Same FLAT/ROUTE calibration-logit rule and zero-gate reduction
Raw-zero startup, strict finite history, session isolation, inactive freeze, native-unit output and versioned invalidation

h1.official_batch_max: bind actual H1 protocol; do not infer

other: Explicit predeclared temporal member from the finite family, fixed within each FLAT/ROUTE pair
Frozen carrier provenance and legal calibration support
Documented I/O-only preprocessing and output calibration
Predeclared training numbers matched within each dataset FLAT/ROUTE pair

fixed: The same declared temporal member within each dataset pair

parallel_hypotheses_reviewed.m1_like: FW-QueryAge16 retained as an allowed explicit backbone member; not renamed ROUTE and not assumed accurate on M2/H1.
parallel_hypotheses_reviewed.fusion: FW-C1Q3-PE: one causal context layer plus three current-query reads; requires same-position/same-Norm contextual_depth 0/1/3 controls. Not a default and not ordinary KV cache.
parallel_hypotheses_reviewed.if_backbones_differ_across_datasets: Within-dataset FLAT/ROUTE pairs can support a routing-method claim for the tested dataset/backbone combinations; not an identical-network or temporal-superiority claim.
parallel_hypotheses_reviewed.if_temporal_superiority_or_interaction_i: Require the routing x temporal crossed controls on every relevant dataset; do not attribute a dataset/backbone confound to a universal temporal kernel.

retrain.m1: Existing FULL is an A-family migration candidate subject to strict equivalence; T e6 cannot be relabeled causal. New matched FLAT/ROUTE evidence is required.
retrain.m2: Existing causal SMALL can be retained after equivalence-only port; new ROUTE or query/fusion requires matched training.
retrain.h1: Signed V4/V6/V7 cannot populate the common-frontend family. Common-frontend learning and matched FLAT/ROUTE need fresh verification/training; naive timeout alone does not invalidate old causal weights.

keeps.C2: Separate SPINT control; 581920 is not a B-transformer.
keeps.581973: Historical causal SMALL official result only; never use official score for new selection.
keeps.M1_T_e6: Historical source-dev current-query and live V3 runtime control, not official generalization or ROUTE evidence.
keeps.H1_signed: Honest local signed-frontend diagnostics under original names, not common-frontend family results.

rejects: Relabeling query-memory or signed-mixing as existing ROUTE
Calling final-layer last-query exact-E a new fusion architecture
Cross-window contextual KV reuse under the finite-window causal contract
Treating H1 V6 recency prior as an unmarked family definition
Resurrecting deleted M1 naive image or closed FiLM/C3/q3-AFC4 paths
Overwriting historical artifacts or making official-score-driven choices
